versions.changelog:
- Initial release of laptop-buying-consultant.
- Provides tailored laptop recommendations through structured, targeted questions on use case, portability, display, OS, region, and more.
- Focuses on unbiased spec recommendations—no brand or sales bias.
- Designed to educate users so they can confidently choose specs without relying on salespeople.
- Clearly guides users on when and how to use the skill for optimal results.
